-- 01 · ABOUT

Who's behind the queries

I'm a Computer and Data Science student at Alexandria University with a strong interest in data analysis and business intelligence. I enjoy transforming raw, complex data into meaningful insights using Python, SQL, Excel and Power BI.

Through academic projects and practical training, I've gained hands-on experience in data cleaning, exploratory data analysis, data visualization and dashboard development.

I'm continuously sharpening my technical and analytical skills while building real-world projects — and I'm looking for opportunities to apply data-driven solutions to real business problems.
